changes.reason: wet is about water, not heat; no sense of HOT (temperature, spicy, popular, stolen) has wet as its reverse (wet reverses dry). Not a twin of hot either. Tag fits: a different-dimension word picked because it is unlike the twins. Execution correct, names cold as the opposite.

heavy is weight, not contents; no sense of EMPTY (contains nothing, meaningless, vacant) is reversed by heavy, and a fair marker would not accept 'empty bags are light' as making heavy an opposite. Full stays clearly the key. Not a twin. Execution correct.
beside is a side position; ABOVE is reversed only by below/under. Not a twin of above (over, upstairs are). Tag fits; execution correct.

REFUSED: hard is a defensible opposite of the bare card SMOOTH in a common sense. SMOOTH also means free of difficulty ('it all went smoothly', 'a smooth journey', 'a smooth landing'), and HARD meaning difficult is the sense a 9-11-year-old knows best, so a careful child can argue smooth (easy) / hard (difficult) — and 'a smooth landing / a hard landing' is a real pairing. The row's own twin 'silky' also primes the soft/hard pair. Two defensible opposites on a bare card is a broken row, so this seat may not land even though the door target then falls short.
lazy is about effort, not fear; no sense of BRAVE is reversed by it (timid/cowardly/fearful are). Not a twin. Tag fits; execution correct.
short reverses long/tall, not WIDE; no sense of wide (broad, far off the mark, extensive) is reversed by short. Not a twin. Tag fits; execution correct ('a road can be short and wide at once').
wide measures across; no sense of DEEP (depth, low voice, deep sleep, deep colour, deep thought) is reversed by wide (those take shallow, high, light, pale). Not a twin. Tag fits; execution correct.
wait is delaying a start, not ending; BEGIN is reversed by finish/end/stop, and wait does not mean any of them. Not a twin. Tag fits; execution correct.
a draw is neither win nor loss; VICTORY is reversed by defeat/loss, and a careful child cannot argue a draw is the reverse of winning. Not a twin. Defeat remains clearly the key. Execution correct.
shiny is about appearance, not age; ANCIENT is reversed by modern/new and shiny is not a sense of new. Not a twin. Tag fits; execution correct.

travel is being on the journey, not leaving; ARRIVE is reversed by depart/leave/set off, and no thesaurus sense of arrive takes travel as its reverse. Not a twin. Depart stays clearly the key. Execution correct.
bend changes shape, not size; EXPAND is reversed by shrink/contract. Not a twin (stretch, grow are). Tag fits; execution correct ('a bent wire is as long as before').

anger is a different unhappy feeling; JOY is reversed by sorrow/sadness/misery, and anger is not a recognised opposite of joy in any sense. Not a twin. Sorrow remains clearly the key for a child who knows both words. Execution correct.

rows.reason: HOT: cold, warm, spicy, wet. Only cold reverses hot in any sense (no 'mild' for the spicy sense). Warm/spicy are twins, wet is unrelated: not three-alike. All words known.
EMPTY: full, hollow, blank, heavy. Only full reverses empty in any sense. Splits 2 twins (hollow, blank) + heavy + key. All words known.
ABOVE: below, over, upstairs, beside. Only below reverses above. Twins over/upstairs, beside unrelated: not three-alike. All words known.

Row as proposed (SMOOTH: rough, flat->hard, silky, even) carries hard, a defensible second opposite of the bare card (smooth = trouble-free vs hard = difficult; 'smooth/hard landing'), so rough is not the only correct option under every reading. The seat is refused; the LIVE row stays as it is (flat, silky, even, still three-alike). Needs a different loose distractor with no easy/difficult or texture sense reversing smooth.
BRAVE: timid, bold, daring, lazy. Only timid reverses brave. Twins bold/daring, lazy unrelated. All words known.
WIDE: narrow, broad, baggy, short. Only narrow reverses wide. Twins broad/baggy, short unrelated; even by size the options split 2/2. All words known.
DEEP: shallow, dark, bottomless, wide. Only shallow reverses deep in any sense (high, light, pale not on the row). Not three-alike. All words known.
BEGIN: finish, start, open, wait. Only finish reverses begin (no end/stop on the row). Twins start/open, wait unrelated. All words known.
VICTORY: defeat, triumph, win, draw. Only defeat reverses victory. Twins triumph/win, draw neither. All words known.
ANCIENT: modern, old, antique, shiny. Only modern reverses ancient. Twins old/antique, shiny unrelated. All words known.
ARRIVE: depart, reach, come, travel. Only depart reverses arrive. Twins reach/come, travel not a reverse. All words known.
EXPAND: shrink, stretch, grow, bend. Only shrink reverses expand. Twins stretch/grow, bend unrelated. All words known.
JOY: sorrow, delight, happiness, anger. Only sorrow reverses joy. Twins delight/happiness, anger a different feeling. All words known.
